title: Trick or Treat
description: The most popular game show in America. Contestants take turns asking trick questions. If you manage to trick the host, you will be awarded a pumpkin point. The player with the most pumpkin points by the end of the game wins.
alt1: two teen contestants in Hallowen costumes, a boy in prisoner costume, and a girl in a princess costume
alt2: girl screaming, strapped to a wheel and spinning around
alt3: boy with Dracula host and a woman helper dressed as a witch
alt4: boy climing a big rope spider web retrieving fake bugs
